# Arpan Foundation Incorporated

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **partial** · Confirmed identity and pass-through model, themes and two named partner NGOs, and located six years of Form 990 contribution figures. Could not find a public application process/RFP, INR-denominated CSR-style spend breakdown, state/district footprint, or disclosed per-grant amounts. The funder reports in USD via IRS Form 990; the catalog's Money type only accepts inr/lakh/crore, so the USD contribution figures found are reported in the summary but were not forced into csr_spend/csr_year records to avoid misstating currency.

Arpan Foundation Incorporated (EIN 20-5593243, arpanfoundation.org) is a US-based 501(c)(3) that raises donations in the US and passes 100% through, without overhead deduction, to grassroots partner institutions in India, chosen by donors from a curated list of roughly 20 organisations (per its Benevity profile). Officers listed on its Form 990s are Parag Karia (Chairman) and Purnima Karia (Director), unpaid. Its self-described themes are education, healthcare and rehabilitation, water conservation/drought prevention, reducing malnutrition, and women's empowerment. Two named India partners appear on its website: Snehalaya (est. 1989, works with women and children affected by commercial sexual exploitation) and Shraddha Rehabilitation Foundation (est. 1988, cares for homeless people with mental illness). IRS Form 990 filings via ProPublica show total contributions received of $3,437,101 (FYE June 2025), $1,564,721 (FYE June 2024), $1,080,009 (FYE June 2023), $1,412,440 (FYE June 2022), $1,206,304 (FYE June 2021) and $1,569,829 (FYE June 2020) — not saved as csr_spend/csr_year because that schema requires INR/lakh/crore units and these are USD. No breakdown by recipient or India state/district is disclosed anywhere found. No public grant application process, eligibility criteria, deadlines or role-based contact mailbox were found (Join Us/FAQ pages returned 404/403; Benevity shows only a masked individual email). This entity is confirmed distinct from Arpan (arpan.org.in), the Mumbai-based child sexual abuse prevention NGO in India, and from a separate, unrelated 'Arpan Foundation' entities at arpan-foundation.com and arpan.org (Rajasthan folk-music heritage). Note: the initial research_goals/funder_dossier calls for 'Arpan Foundation USA' returned catalog data for an unrelated entity, Adani Foundation [funder:15] — an apparent fuzzy-match error in the lookup tool — and that data was disregarded entirely as not pertaining to Arpan.

Website: https://www.arpanfoundation.org

## What it set out to find

- Confirm legal identity of Arpan Foundation USA and distinguish it from Arpan (India, Mumbai-based CSA-prevention NGO at arpan.org.in) and from any other same-named entity
- Website, entity type, EIN/registration identifiers
- Latest annual grant/disbursement figures to India and 2-3 prior years, FY-labelled
- Themes and India states/districts where funded work actually ran vs stated priority geography
- Named grantee/partner NGOs in India, project titles, amounts, years
- Typical grant size, eligibility, application process, intake status, current RFPs/deadlines, contact point
- Evidence: annual report/Form 990, website, partner project pages
